finding: finding-lint and dispatch_lib each parse the frontmatter and the section ## Possible damage, and the two parsers disagree. A critical finding whose damage item starts with '* ' passes finding-lint, and the stop notice then prints no damage item. The value Null of stop_confirmed_by is text in finding-lint and null in dispatch_lib. The review reproduced both with the functions of the branch head. Move the parsing into one module beside both scripts and let both import it, and add a test that feeds one fixture to both.
why_this_severity: mdformat writes every bullet as '- ' and the template writes the human fields as null, so real files give the same result in both parsers (no to fails_purpose). Each later change of the finding format must be made in two places that already disagree, which is a duplicated rule.
